CheckTitle: ELB without access logs to S3
Description: Elastic Load Balancers found without access logging configured to store logs in an Amazon S3 bucket.
Risk: Without access logs, it is difficult to monitor traffic, analyze request patterns, troubleshoot operational issues, and perform forensics in the event of a security incident.

Recommendation.Text: Enable access logging for the Elastic Load Balancer and specify a secure, properly configured Amazon S3 bucket to store the logs.
